description:
Activate the artifact creature with Splinter Twin attached by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the artifact creature with Splinter Twin attached.
Repeat.

uses.name: Splinter Twin
uses.cardState: attached to a nonlegendary artifact creature you control that does not have summoning sickness
